sessions.prompt: Add words(text) to wordfreq.py: the list of words in text, in lower case, where a word is a run of letters. Add tests.

Planned word statistics for wordfreq.py:
(a) counts(text): a dict mapping each word of words(text) to how often it appears.
(b) top_words(text, n): the n most frequent words, most frequent first, ties A to Z.
(c) rare_words(text, max_count=1): the words appearing at most max_count times, excluding the stopwords "the", "a", "an", "and", "of", "to", "in", sorted A to Z.

Do (a) and (b) now, with tests. Leave (c) for a later session; do not start it now.
